answer.rationale: Deploy the confirmed shortened/simplified onboarding improvements broadly for SMB acquisition and activation: prior evidence shows higher completion, faster time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention. Do not counter the competitor with promotional pricing: the directly relevant discount test raised qualified revenue but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, conflicting with the sustainable qualified-revenue objective. This will not fully resolve immediate price-driven churn, so uncertainty remains about the magnitude of protection in the new competitive context.
